import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Column aliases for readability
    t1_enr = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    t1_app = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    t1_woe = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    t1_eval = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    t1_cred = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'
    t1_grade = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    t2_enr = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    t2_app = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    t2_woe = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    t2_eval = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    t2_cred = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'
    t2_grade = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    fee_up = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    debtor = 'Debtor'
    scholar = 'Scholarship holder'

    age_col = 'Age at enrollment'
    sched_col = 'Daytime/evening attendance\t'

    adm_grade = 'Admission grade'
    prev_grade = 'Previous qualification (grade)'

    gdp_col = 'GDP'
    unemp_col = 'Unemployment rate'
    infl_col = 'Inflation rate'

    app_order = 'Application order'
    target_col = 'Target'

    # Basic integrity checks for features used immediately below
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df[target_col].notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 1 constraints that guard downstream ratios and normalizations
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = df[t1_grade].between(0, 20)
    cond2 = (df[t1_app] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond3 = (df[t1_woe] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond4 = (df[t1_eval] >= df[t1_app])
    cond5 = (df[t1_cred] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond6 = (~(df[t1_woe] == df[t1_enr])) | (df[t1_app] == 0)
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 1 derived features
    t1_pass_rate = (df[t1_app] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_eval_rate = (df[t1_eval] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_no_eval_ratio = (df[t1_woe] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_credit_rate = (df[t1_cred] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_grade_norm = (df[t1_grade] / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Term 2 constraints guarding similar downstream ratios and correlation-weighted blending
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = df[t2_grade].between(0, 20)
    cond2 = (df[t2_app] <= df[t2_enr])
    cond3 = (df[t2_woe] <= df[t2_enr])
    cond4 = (df[t2_eval] >= df[t2_app])
    cond5 = (df[t2_cred] <= df[t2_enr])
    corr_enr_eval = df[t2_enr].corr(df[t2_eval])
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and (corr_enr_eval > 0.6)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 2 derived features
    t2_pass_rate = (df[t2_app] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_eval_rate = (df[t2_eval] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_no_eval_ratio = (df[t2_woe] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_credit_rate = (df[t2_cred] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_grade_norm = (df[t2_grade] / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Academic readiness constraints (used to build readiness composite)
    # ASSERTION_START
    a1 = df[adm_grade].between(0, 200)
    a2 = df[prev_grade].between(0, 200)
    a3 = df[adm_grade].corr(df[prev_grade]) > 0.5
    assert a1.all() and a2.all() and a3
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Academic readiness feature
    adm_norm = (df[adm_grade] / 200.0).clip(0, 1)
    prev_norm = (df[prev_grade] / 200.0).clip(0, 1)
    readiness = 0.6 * adm_norm + 0.4 * prev_norm

    # Financial binary constraints and prevalence used to calibrate billing risk
    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = df[fee_up].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c2 = df[debtor].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c3 = df[scholar].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c4 = (~(df[fee_up] == 1)) | (df[debtor] == 0)
    fee_up_rate = (df[fee_up] == 1).mean()
    debtor_rate = (df[debtor] == 1).mean()
    if (df[scholar] == 1).any():
        scholar_fee_up_rate = df.loc[df[scholar] == 1, fee_up].mean()
    else:
        scholar_fee_up_rate = 1.0
    assert c1 and c2 and c3 and c4.all() and (fee_up_rate >= 0.80) and (debtor_rate <= 0.20) and (scholar_fee_up_rate >= 0.85)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Financial risk feature
    base_fin_risk = (1 - df[fee_up]) * 0.7 + df[debtor] * 0.3
    scholarship_dampen = np.where(df[scholar] == 1, 0.9, 1.0)
    financial_risk = (base_fin_risk * scholarship_dampen).clip(0, 1)

    # Schedule and age constraints that shape schedule-age adjustment
    # ASSERTION_START
    s1 = df[age_col].between(16, 80).all()
    s2 = df[sched_col].isin([0, 1]).all()
    mean_age_evening = df.loc[df[sched_col] == 0, age_col].mean()
    mean_age_day = df.loc[df[sched_col] == 1, age_col].mean()
    day_rate = (df[sched_col] == 1).mean()
    assert s1 and s2 and (mean_age_evening >= mean_age_day) and (day_rate >= 0.85)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Schedule-age adjustment feature
    is_evening = (df[sched_col] == 0).astype(int)
    age_norm = (df[age_col] - df[age_col].min()) / (df[age_col].max() - df[age_col].min() + 1e-9)
    schedule_age_adjust = (0.6 * is_evening + 0.4 * age_norm).clip(0, 1)

    # Macroeconomic constraints used to apply cohort-level stress multiplier
    # ASSERTION_START
    g1 = df[gdp_col].between(-10, 10).all()
    g2 = df[unemp_col].between(0, 50).all()
    g3 = df[infl_col].between(-5, 20).all()
    g4 = df[gdp_col].corr(df[unemp_col]) < -0.5
    assert g1 and g2 and g3 and g4
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Macroeconomic stress multiplier (higher unemployment and lower GDP increases multiplier)
    gdp_norm = (df[gdp_col] - df[gdp_col].min()) / (df[gdp_col].max() - df[gdp_col].min() + 1e-9)
    unemp_norm = (df[unemp_col] - df[unemp_col].min()) / (df[unemp_col].max() - df[unemp_col].min() + 1e-9)
    infl_norm = (df[infl_col] - df[infl_col].min()) / (df[infl_col].max() - df[infl_col].min() + 1e-9)
    macro_multiplier = (1.0 + 0.3 * (1 - gdp_norm) + 0.2 * unemp_norm + 0.1 * infl_norm).clip(1.0, 1.6)

    # Application order constraints used to compute entry intent factor
    # ASSERTION_START
    o1 = (df[app_order].astype(int) == df[app_order]).all() and df[app_order].between(0, 9).all()
    within_1_6 = df[app_order].between(1, 6).mean()
    most_freq = df[app_order].mode(dropna=False).iloc[0]
    assert o1 and (within_1_6 >= 0.95) and (most_freq == 1)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Entry intent factor: lower application order suggests stronger intent
    app_order_adj = df[app_order].replace(0, 10)
    intent_factor = ((7 - app_order_adj).clip(1, 6) / 6.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Academic performance composite (term 1 and term 2). Weight term 2 evaluation features by observed correlation.
    term2_weight = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, corr_enr_eval)))
    t1_component = (0.5 * t1_pass_rate + 0.2 * t1_eval_rate + 0.3 * t1_grade_norm - 0.2 * (1 - t1_credit_rate) - 0.1 * t1_no_eval_ratio)
    t2_component_raw = (0.5 * t2_pass_rate + 0.2 * t2_eval_rate + 0.3 * t2_grade_norm - 0.2 * (1 - t2_credit_rate) - 0.1 * t2_no_eval_ratio)
    t2_component = term2_weight * t2_component_raw + (1 - term2_weight) * 0.5 * (t2_pass_rate + t1_pass_rate)
    academic_progress_score = (0.6 * t1_component + 0.4 * t2_component).clip(0, 1)

    # Combine readiness (prior) with current progress and intent
    academic_strength = (0.5 * academic_progress_score + 0.3 * readiness + 0.2 * intent_factor).clip(0, 1)
    academic_risk = (1 - academic_strength).clip(0, 1)

    # Target constraints used to calibrate risk thresholding
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_targets = {'Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'}
    assert df[target_col].isin(valid_targets).all()
    counts = df[target_col].value_counts(dropna=False)
    assert counts.idxmax() == 'Graduate'
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Retention risk score combining academic, financial, schedule-age, and macro stress
    base_risk = (0.6 * academic_risk + 0.35 * financial_risk + 0.05 * schedule_age_adjust).clip(0, 1)
    retention_risk_score = (base_risk * macro_multiplier).clip(0, 1)

    # Data-driven threshold: flag top share roughly equal to observed dropout prior
    dropout_prior = (df[target_col] == 'Dropout').mean()
    threshold = float(np.quantile(retention_risk_score, max(0.0, min(1.0, 1 - dropout_prior))))
    at_risk = retention_risk_score >= threshold

    # Outreach routing based on dominant risk source
    academic_high = academic_risk >= academic_risk.quantile(0.70)
    financial_high = financial_risk >= financial_risk.quantile(0.70)
    outreach = np.where(academic_high & financial_high, 'both', np.where(academic_high, 'academic', np.where(financial_high, 'billing', 'none')))

    # Outputs
    out_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_id': np.arange(len(df)),
        'retention_risk_score': retention_risk_score,
        'academic_risk': academic_risk,
        'financial_risk': financial_risk,
        'schedule_age_adjust': schedule_age_adjust,
        'macro_multiplier': macro_multiplier,
        'at_risk': at_risk,
        'recommended_outreach': outreach,
        'Target': df[target_col]
    })

    out_scores_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'retention_scores.csv')
    out_queue_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'outreach_queue.csv')
    out_df.to_csv(out_scores_path, index=False)

    queue_df = out_df.loc[out_df['at_risk'] & (out_df['recommended_outreach'] != 'none'), ['student_id', 'retention_risk_score', 'recommended_outreach']]
    queue_df = queue_df.sort_values(by='retention_risk_score', ascending=False)
    queue_df.to_csv(out_queue_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Column aliases for readability
    t1_enr = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    t1_app = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    t1_woe = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    t1_eval = 'Curricular units 1st sem (evaluations)'
    t1_cred = 'Curricular units 1st sem (credited)'
    t1_grade = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    t2_enr = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    t2_app = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    t2_woe = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    t2_eval = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (evaluations)'
    t2_cred = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (credited)'
    t2_grade = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    fee_up = 'Tuition fees up to date'
    debtor = 'Debtor'
    scholar = 'Scholarship holder'

    age_col = 'Age at enrollment'
    sched_col = 'Daytime/evening attendance\t'

    adm_grade = 'Admission grade'
    prev_grade = 'Previous qualification (grade)'

    gdp_col = 'GDP'
    unemp_col = 'Unemployment rate'
    infl_col = 'Inflation rate'

    app_order = 'Application order'
    target_col = 'Target'

    # Basic integrity checks for features used immediately below
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df[target_col].notna().all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 1 constraints that guard downstream ratios and normalizations
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = df[t1_grade].between(0, 20)
    cond2 = (df[t1_app] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond3 = (df[t1_woe] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond4 = (df[t1_eval] >= df[t1_app])
    cond5 = (df[t1_cred] <= df[t1_enr])
    cond6 = (~(df[t1_woe] == df[t1_enr])) | (df[t1_app] == 0)
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and cond6.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 1 derived features
    t1_pass_rate = (df[t1_app] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_eval_rate = (df[t1_eval] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_no_eval_ratio = (df[t1_woe] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_credit_rate = (df[t1_cred] / df[t1_enr].where(df[t1_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t1_grade_norm = (df[t1_grade] / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Term 2 constraints guarding similar downstream ratios and correlation-weighted blending
    # ASSERTION_START
    cond1 = df[t2_grade].between(0, 20)
    cond2 = (df[t2_app] <= df[t2_enr])
    cond3 = (df[t2_woe] <= df[t2_enr])
    cond4 = (df[t2_eval] >= df[t2_app])
    cond5 = (df[t2_cred] <= df[t2_enr])
    corr_enr_eval = df[t2_enr].corr(df[t2_eval])
    assert cond1.all() and cond2.all() and cond3.all() and cond4.all() and cond5.all() and (corr_enr_eval > 0.6)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Term 2 derived features
    t2_pass_rate = (df[t2_app] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_eval_rate = (df[t2_eval] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_no_eval_ratio = (df[t2_woe] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_credit_rate = (df[t2_cred] / df[t2_enr].where(df[t2_enr] != 0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0).clip(0, 1)
    t2_grade_norm = (df[t2_grade] / 20.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Academic readiness constraints (used to build readiness composite)
    # ASSERTION_START
    a1 = df[adm_grade].between(0, 200)
    a2 = df[prev_grade].between(0, 200)
    a3 = df[adm_grade].corr(df[prev_grade]) > 0.5
    assert a1.all() and a2.all() and a3
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Academic readiness feature
    adm_norm = (df[adm_grade] / 200.0).clip(0, 1)
    prev_norm = (df[prev_grade] / 200.0).clip(0, 1)
    readiness = 0.6 * adm_norm + 0.4 * prev_norm

    # Financial binary constraints and prevalence used to calibrate billing risk
    # ASSERTION_START
    c1 = df[fee_up].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c2 = df[debtor].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c3 = df[scholar].isin([0, 1]).all()
    c4 = (~(df[fee_up] == 1)) | (df[debtor] == 0)
    fee_up_rate = (df[fee_up] == 1).mean()
    debtor_rate = (df[debtor] == 1).mean()
    if (df[scholar] == 1).any():
        scholar_fee_up_rate = df.loc[df[scholar] == 1, fee_up].mean()
    else:
        scholar_fee_up_rate = 1.0
    assert c1 and c2 and c3 and c4.all() and (fee_up_rate >= 0.80) and (debtor_rate <= 0.20) and (scholar_fee_up_rate >= 0.85)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Financial risk feature
    base_fin_risk = (1 - df[fee_up]) * 0.7 + df[debtor] * 0.3
    scholarship_dampen = np.where(df[scholar] == 1, 0.9, 1.0)
    financial_risk = (base_fin_risk * scholarship_dampen).clip(0, 1)

    # Schedule and age constraints that shape schedule-age adjustment
    # ASSERTION_START
    s1 = df[age_col].between(16, 80).all()
    s2 = df[sched_col].isin([0, 1]).all()
    mean_age_evening = df.loc[df[sched_col] == 0, age_col].mean()
    mean_age_day = df.loc[df[sched_col] == 1, age_col].mean()
    day_rate = (df[sched_col] == 1).mean()
    assert s1 and s2 and (mean_age_evening >= mean_age_day) and (day_rate >= 0.85)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Schedule-age adjustment feature
    is_evening = (df[sched_col] == 0).astype(int)
    age_norm = (df[age_col] - df[age_col].min()) / (df[age_col].max() - df[age_col].min() + 1e-9)
    schedule_age_adjust = (0.6 * is_evening + 0.4 * age_norm).clip(0, 1)

    # Macroeconomic constraints used to apply cohort-level stress multiplier
    # ASSERTION_START
    g1 = df[gdp_col].between(-10, 10).all()
    g2 = df[unemp_col].between(0, 50).all()
    g3 = df[infl_col].between(-5, 20).all()
    g4 = df[gdp_col].corr(df[unemp_col]) < -0.5
    assert g1 and g2 and g3 and g4
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Macroeconomic stress multiplier (higher unemployment and lower GDP increases multiplier)
    gdp_norm = (df[gdp_col] - df[gdp_col].min()) / (df[gdp_col].max() - df[gdp_col].min() + 1e-9)
    unemp_norm = (df[unemp_col] - df[unemp_col].min()) / (df[unemp_col].max() - df[unemp_col].min() + 1e-9)
    infl_norm = (df[infl_col] - df[infl_col].min()) / (df[infl_col].max() - df[infl_col].min() + 1e-9)
    macro_multiplier = (1.0 + 0.3 * (1 - gdp_norm) + 0.2 * unemp_norm + 0.1 * infl_norm).clip(1.0, 1.6)

    # Application order constraints used to compute entry intent factor
    # ASSERTION_START
    o1 = (df[app_order].astype(int) == df[app_order]).all() and df[app_order].between(0, 9).all()
    within_1_6 = df[app_order].between(1, 6).mean()
    most_freq = df[app_order].mode(dropna=False).iloc[0]
    assert o1 and (within_1_6 >= 0.95) and (most_freq == 1)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Entry intent factor: lower application order suggests stronger intent
    app_order_adj = df[app_order].replace(0, 10)
    intent_factor = ((7 - app_order_adj).clip(1, 6) / 6.0).clip(0, 1)

    # Academic performance composite (term 1 and term 2). Weight term 2 evaluation features by observed correlation.
    term2_weight = float(max(0.0, min(1.0, corr_enr_eval)))
    t1_component = (0.5 * t1_pass_rate + 0.2 * t1_eval_rate + 0.3 * t1_grade_norm - 0.2 * (1 - t1_credit_rate) - 0.1 * t1_no_eval_ratio)
    t2_component_raw = (0.5 * t2_pass_rate + 0.2 * t2_eval_rate + 0.3 * t2_grade_norm - 0.2 * (1 - t2_credit_rate) - 0.1 * t2_no_eval_ratio)
    t2_component = term2_weight * t2_component_raw + (1 - term2_weight) * 0.5 * (t2_pass_rate + t1_pass_rate)
    academic_progress_score = (0.6 * t1_component + 0.4 * t2_component).clip(0, 1)

    # Combine readiness (prior) with current progress and intent
    academic_strength = (0.5 * academic_progress_score + 0.3 * readiness + 0.2 * intent_factor).clip(0, 1)
    academic_risk = (1 - academic_strength).clip(0, 1)

    # Target constraints used to calibrate risk thresholding
    # ASSERTION_START
    valid_targets = {'Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'}
    assert df[target_col].isin(valid_targets).all()
    counts = df[target_col].value_counts(dropna=False)
    assert counts.idxmax() == 'Graduate'
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Retention risk score combining academic, financial, schedule-age, and macro stress
    base_risk = (0.6 * academic_risk + 0.35 * financial_risk + 0.05 * schedule_age_adjust).clip(0, 1)
    retention_risk_score = (base_risk * macro_multiplier).clip(0, 1)

    # Data-driven threshold: flag top share roughly equal to observed dropout prior
    dropout_prior = (df[target_col] == 'Dropout').mean()
    threshold = float(np.quantile(retention_risk_score, max(0.0, min(1.0, 1 - dropout_prior))))
    at_risk = retention_risk_score >= threshold

    # Outreach routing based on dominant risk source
    academic_high = academic_risk >= academic_risk.quantile(0.70)
    financial_high = financial_risk >= financial_risk.quantile(0.70)
    outreach = np.where(academic_high & financial_high, 'both', np.where(academic_high, 'academic', np.where(financial_high, 'billing', 'none')))

    # Outputs
    out_df = pd.DataFrame({
        'student_id': np.arange(len(df)),
        'retention_risk_score': retention_risk_score,
        'academic_risk': academic_risk,
        'financial_risk': financial_risk,
        'schedule_age_adjust': schedule_age_adjust,
        'macro_multiplier': macro_multiplier,
        'at_risk': at_risk,
        'recommended_outreach': outreach,
        'Target': df[target_col]
    })

    out_scores_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'retention_scores.csv')
    out_queue_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'outreach_queue.csv')
    out_df.to_csv(out_scores_path, index=False)

    queue_df = out_df.loc[out_df['at_risk'] & (out_df['recommended_outreach'] != 'none'), ['student_id', 'retention_risk_score', 'recommended_outreach']]
    queue_df = queue_df.sort_values(by='retention_risk_score', ascending=False)
    queue_df.to_csv(out_queue_path, index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
